THE SCENE

You host the school talk show. Today the show is in the library, in front of the ninth grade. Today's question is: how did writing change the Cherokee people? You start the show with a short welcome. It has time for three facts, not four. Four people near the stage each have one fact.

THE HISTORY

This show is about Sequoyah, a Cherokee man. He could not read or write any language. Then he made a way to write Cherokee. Soon, thousands of Cherokee people could read it.
